free_tier.stated: Keyless and anonymous: a public instance takes GET /search?q=...&format=json with no key or account. Each instance is run by its own operator and listed on searx.space. JSON output is off by default (search.formats lists html only) and an operator must enable it. Asked a scripted format=json query on 2026-10-31, none of 20 listed instances returned results: 14 answered 429 Too Many Requests, 3 a bot-challenge page, 1 a 418 cookie-setting script, 1 a 403 and 1 a redirect to its front page; a plain query without format=json returned no results from any of the 20 either (16 answered 429, 3 a bot-challenge page, 1 a 418).

retention.stated: an instance disappears with its operator

egress.terms: not applicable: HTML or JSON, and JSON is off by default

chaining: Public instances do not chain as a scripted search source, since every listed instance probed on 2026-10-31 answered a scripted query with 429, 403, 418, a redirect or a bot-challenge page; scripted search goes to the hosted search APIs of this topic (for example crawler-scraper/tavily, crawler-scraper/exa and crawler-scraper/youdotcom), and a self-run SearXNG instance with the json format enabled is the last resort.
